# What locum rate beats your employed offer?

> Free locum tenens vs employed calculator for physicians, NPs, PAs and CRNAs. Compare a 1099 locum contract with a W-2 offer: take-home after federal tax, self-employment tax, malpractice tail, benefits, unpaid gaps, and the break-even locum hourly rate. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
